system.flavor: 40mm flash-bang: Stun/Shock Save at -2 within 5 m (15 m indoors).
system.notes:
THE BOOK: Home of the Brave p.86, "Flash-Bang: A time-delay charge of blasting explosive and flash-powder, the flash-bang round acts as a normal flash-bang grenade. All people within 5 meters of the blast (15 meters if indoors) must make a Stun/Shock Save at -2" (stunned and deafened 4 turns; a Difficulty 20+ REF test or blinded 2 turns; anti-dazzle protection negates the flash). Maximum range 25 m; it arms 10 m out.

MODEL: the radius is the outdoor 5 m; indoors, widen the area to 15 m by hand. The deafness and the REF test are by hand.
